display_name: MarkerNet R34 + 目盛 OCR 自動校正 (方式C、方式A の後処理)
architecture: MarkerNet: ResNet-34 (ImageNet) + U-Net decoder to stride 2, CenterNet heatmap + offset + shape class + associative embedding
data: 方式A (b) と同じ重み(合成 + Starrydata × CC-BY 実図)
post_processing_chosen_on: validation split of the training data + stress validation set (scripts/train/marker_detector/tune_post.py)
calibration: automatic: frame rules + Tesseract tick OCR (adapter/auto_axis_calibration.py)
seconds_note: detector forward on CPU (16 threads) + post-processing; noaxis adds the automatic calibration (Tesseract)
